title: J7oF
description: High-performance Fabric 1.21.1 pack. Boosts FPS with Sodium/Iris & adds essential tools like JEI, Jade, and Graves for a better Vanilla+.
body:
**Ultimate Efficiency & Utility Pack (Fabric 1.21.1) **
Enhance your Minecraft experience with this lightweight, high-performance modpack. Designed for players who want a smoother game, better visuals, and essential tools without changing the core "Vanilla" feeling.

✨ Key Features:
🚀 Extreme Performance: Powered by Sodium and Iris, giving you the highest possible FPS and seamless shader support.

🛠️ Essential Utilities: Includes JEI (Just Enough Items) for all your recipe needs and Jade to show you exactly what block or mob you are looking at.

🛡️ Quality of Life: * Graves: Never lose your items again; a grave spawns where you die.

WI-Zoom: Get a closer look at distant objects easily.

WeaponMaster: See your weapons and tools visually on your character's back/hip.

🏗️ Better Building: Reacharound allows you to place blocks in mid-air or around corners more easily, similar to Bedrock Edition.

💡 Visual Utility: Resource Gamma Util helps you manage brightness and visibility in dark caves.

⚙️ Technical Information:
Version: Minecraft 1.21.1

Mod Loader: Fabric

Optimization: Highly optimized for low-end PCs and high-refresh-rate monitors.

📦 Included Mods:
Sodium & Iris (Graphics & Shaders)

JEI & Jade (Information & Recipes)

Graves & WeaponMaster (Immersive Gameplay)

Polymer & Reacharound (Building & Logic)
